page.title: Text Extraction
page.intro: A playground for the API: every form here sends one request to {path} with your key.
login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with an API key of this service. The key stays in this tab and is sent as a header with each request.
hint.api_key: Your key of this service: kept in this tab only and sent only as the {header} header.
hint.llm_key: Optional: your own key for the LLM endpoint, which takes precedence over the operator's key. Kept in this tab only and sent only as this header.
hint.asr_key: Optional: your own key for the speech recognition endpoint, which takes precedence over the operator's key. Kept in this tab only and sent only as this header.
switch.label: Language
switch.hint: Switching the language reloads the page. You stay logged in; an open job view closes, but its jobs keep running.
hint.access.respect: The checks of robots.txt and the TDM opt-out apply as this service is set up.
hint.access.maximum: For sites that allowed extraction by contract: sends {value}, so the checks are off, and a page that refuses (HTTP 403, 429 or 503) or gives too little text falls back to the unblock browser. The outbound limits and a host's pause still apply.
hint.access.maximum_site: For sites that allowed extraction by contract: sends {value}, so the checks are off. A site crawl reads its pages over HTTP only and never uses the browser.
hint.access.off: Not available: maximum extraction needs {browser} and {unblock} switched on in this deployment.
mode.label: Browser fallback
mode.no_browser: This deployment has no browser ({setting} is off), so "always" is not available.
mode.fast_with_maximum: With maximum extraction, "never" stays with HTTP: the page never reaches the browser.
shell.banner: This service runs without authentication: anyone who can reach it can use the API and this UI.
form.wait: Wait seconds before it becomes a job
hint.options: Any further field of the REST body, merged under the fields above; a field left at its default yields to the same key here.
hint.urls: More URLs than one batch takes ({setting}) are sent as several batches.
form.batch_file: CSV or JSON file of URLs
hint.batch_file: A CSV with a {column} column (or the URLs in its first column), delimited by commas, semicolons or tabs; or a JSON array of URLs or of objects with {column}. The service checks it and shows a preview first.
form.url_or_text: A URL or a text, not both.
form.scope_path: path: only below the start URL's directory
help.info.intro: The service's name and version, and who this key is.
progress.keep_running: The jobs below were started and keep running.
progress.site_total: The total grows while it crawls.
progress.cancel_confirm: Cancel this job and delete it with its results?
progress.cancelled: Job {id} ({kind}) was cancelled and deleted with its results.
result.previews_hint: The service fetches the images with its own checks; the image hosts do not see you.
tree.label: Site tree
tree.title: Site tree of job {id}
tree.snapshot: A snapshot: the job is still running.
warning.browser_unavailable: No browser worker took the page in time: this is the fast result.
warning.navigation_refused_non_get: The browser refused a navigation that was not a GET.
warning.consent_overlay_removed: A cookie or consent overlay was removed before reading.
warning.screenshot_clipped: The screenshot was cut at the height limit.
warning.browser_bytes_capped: The browser stopped loading at the byte limit.
warning.challenge_checkbox_clicked: A challenge checkbox was clicked (unblock mode).
warning.challenge_not_cleared: The bot challenge was not cleared.
warning.browser_profile_left: The browser profile was released after the page.
warning.ocr_unavailable: The document needed OCR, which was not available: its text layer only.
warning.pages_truncated: Pages after the page limit were cut.
warning.pages_partial: OCR stopped at its time limit or skipped a page: the pages it read.
warning.document_fetched_directly: The render ended on a file, which was fetched and converted.
warning.subtitles_blocked: The platform refused the subtitles: the metadata answers.
warning.subtitles_failed: The subtitles could not be read this time: the metadata answers.
warning.asr_unavailable: No transcription in time, or it failed: the metadata answers.
warning.tracks_truncated: More tracks than the limit: the first ones.
warning.tracks_failed: No track of the page could be read.
warning.content_not_stored_too_large: The job item was stored without its content (too large).
warning.chunks_not_stored_too_large: The job item was stored without its chunks (too large).
warning.tables_not_stored_too_large: The job item was stored without its tables (too large).
warning.pii_entities_truncated: More personal data than the item limit: the counts are complete.
warning.pii_language_unsupported: The language has no PII model: the fallback model was used.
warning.structured_value_invalid: A value did not fit its field's type: the field is missing.
warning.pattern_timeout: A pattern ran into its time limit: the next strategy looked it up.
warning.llm_unavailable: The service has no LLM: the fields it would have read stay missing.
warning.llm_input_truncated: The content was cut to the model's input limit for the LLM.
warning.learned_selectors_unavailable: Learned selectors could not be read or stored this time.
warning.nothing_to_learn: No field went to the LLM, so there was nothing to learn from.
warning.selector_learning_failed: Learning selectors failed: the values stand, nothing learned.
warning.selectors_skipped_large_page: The page has over 50,000 elements: no selector rules ran.
warning.selectors_timed_out: The selector rules did not finish in time: their fields are missing.
warning.selectors_failed: The selector rules could not run: their fields are missing.
warning.structured_truncated: A selector found more than a field's limit: the first values.
warning.tables_truncated: The tables are over 1,000,000 characters: the first ones.
warning.chunks_truncated: More chunks than CHUNK_MAX_CHUNKS: the first ones.
warning.chunking_fallback_recursive: The chunking strategy could not run: recursive was used.
warning.image_not_described: An image was skipped or not described: its description is empty.
warning.sitemap_truncated: The sitemap file was over its size limit: the entries before the cut.
warning.sitemap_urls_truncated: The crawl reached SITE_MAX_SITEMAP_URLS: the first entries.
warning.sitemap_files_truncated: More sitemap files than SITE_MAX_SITEMAP_FILES: the first ones.
warning.links_truncated: More links than SITE_MAX_LINKS_PER_PAGE: the first ones.
warning.max_pages_reached: Links of the page were not followed: the crawl has max_pages pages.
warning.site_memory_guard: Valkey was nearly full: no link of the page was followed.
warning.mcp_content_truncated: The MCP answer holds part of the content: ask for content_offset.

tabs.label: Operations
help.extract.intro: Extract the text of one web page as Markdown or plain text, with its metadata.
help.file.intro: Upload a document, an audio or a video file and get its text.
help.screenshot.intro: Take a screenshot of a web page in the browser.
help.structured.intro: Read named fields from a page: from its metadata, with selectors or patterns, or with an LLM.
help.chunk.intro: Cut a page or a text into chunks, for example for a search index.
help.batch.intro: Extract many URLs at once as a job; its progress shows each URL.
help.batch_file.intro: Start a batch from a CSV or JSON file of URLs, after a preview of the file.
help.site_structure.intro: Crawl a site from a start URL and show its pages as a tree, then extract the pages you select.
hint.url: The address of the page, starting with http:// or https://.
hint.format: Markdown keeps headings, lists, links and tables; text is plain text.
hint.mode: Whether the service loads the page in a browser when the plain HTTP fetch is not enough.
hint.metadata: Title, authors, dates, licence and more, from the page's tags.
hint.metadata_structured: The schema.org and LRMI fields of the page, read by name.
hint.describe_images: Short descriptions of the page's images, written by an LLM (the service's, or the one of your LLM key).
hint.max_images: With "Describe images": how many images get a description.
hint.wait_seconds: How long this page waits for the answer; work that takes longer continues as a job.
hint.file: A document (such as PDF, Word or HTML), an audio or a video file.
hint.full_page: The whole height of the page, up to the service's limit; else the first screen only.
hint.structured: What to read: a strategy, a JSON schema of the fields, and rules if needed.
hint.text: Instead of a URL: the text to cut into chunks.
hint.text_type: With Markdown, the headings guide where the text is cut.
hint.chunking: The strategy and the size of the chunks in characters.
hint.start_url: The page the crawl starts from.
hint.depth: How many links away from the start page the crawl goes (0: the start page only).
hint.max_pages: The crawl stops after this many pages.
hint.sitemaps: Also list the URLs that robots.txt and the site's sitemaps name.
